purpose: Re-characterize the existing bounded 5 cm Ross surface-to-top-node face candidate against an endpoint-aware independent reference on a genuinely fresh holdout, without reusing the invalid inherited steady_q oracle as authority.

fresh_sampling.zero_surface_mapping: h_surface=0 exactly; h_top=-10^(4*b) cm, b in (0,1)
fresh_sampling.overlap_guard: No fresh pair may exactly equal any pair in the original E3E deterministic or independent-holdout set.

reference.primary_all_fresh_cases: R2R1 stable VGM endpoint formulation with 60-digit fixed GL256 t^12 path integration and log-delta root solve using bounded-cost reverse scan
reference.endpoint_policy: R2P: exact h_surface=0 uses q=KSAT and derived plateau only when independent endpoint path is shorter than 5 cm; otherwise solve regular interior q>KSAT root
reference.independent_crosscheck: 100-digit adaptive t^8 oracle on preselected probe ids fresh_zero_0003 and fresh_near_0011 for every material
reference.inherited_steady_q_role: diagnostic only; never qualification authority in this gate

candidate.implementation: existing run_ross01_gate_e3e_5cm_surface_boundary_face.candidate_q using explicit 5 cm geometry and the already persisted E2C/E3A bounded endpoint candidate

qualification_logic.per_material: All fresh probes valid; all reference quality checks pass; all original E3E candidate thresholds pass on the fresh holdout; all frozen crosschecks pass.
qualification_logic.overall: All four materials pass independently. No pooled-average rescue is allowed.
qualification_logic.failure: Persist the first scientifically failing classification without changing thresholds, seeds, candidate or oracle; remediation requires a new gate.

architecture_checks.mass_conservation: Face qualification changes no ledger or state; later column composition must still prove exact mass conservation.
architecture_checks.transactionality: No committed state is mutated by this characterization.
architecture_checks.scratch: reference and candidate numerical temporaries are worker-owned.
architecture_checks.bounded_cost: candidate retains frozen E2C cost caps; expensive independent reference is qualification-only.
architecture_checks.solver_policy_vs_physics: R2P endpoint routing changes neither VGM parameters nor physical options.
architecture_checks.reference_mode: high-accuracy independent reference remains separate from candidate production path.

hard_nonclaims: No full top-boundary, ponding storage, rainfall, evaporation or runoff qualification.
No response tangent qualification across endpoint switching.
No groundwater, runtime, MultiSWAP or production admission.
No conclusion may be based on the superseded inherited steady_q oracle alone.
